summary: Within this candidate chunk, the highest Serenity research priority is Chegg as a speculative shadow candidate because it has clearer public-market purity, identifiable AI-displacement risk, and a testable path to verify whether its content, tutoring, language-learning, or skilling assets can migrate into institutional workflows.
